text:
maria_support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting p95/p99 spikes on tool/function calls around 09:12 UTC. Dashboard shows p95 ~1.1s -> 2.3s and p99 jumping to ~6.2s for /v1/call-tool. Seen on hosted and one Dedicated customer. @anil_runtime @kevin_sre any quick ideas?

anil_runtime: ack, looking. We rolled the stricter structured-output JSON validator (v0.9 stricter rules) last night — could be CPU + sync validation on router path. Can you paste a trace and a sample request?

maria_support: sample trace + log snippet attached below. The interesting bit is the validator latency inside the tool-router.

```
TRACE 09:12:45 request_id=req-xyz model=gptx-3 router=tool-router route=default
router.receive: 12ms
tool-router.validate_json_schema: 480ms
tool-router.call_tool: 60ms
router.kv_cache_lookup: 8ms
total: 620ms
```

Request example (redacted):
```
POST /v1/call-tool
{"input": "summarize long doc", "tools": ["extract_entities","format_json"]}
```

Also seeing occasional schema validation failures (minor), but mostly just long validation time on large arrays/objects in outputs.

kevin_sre: are these strong CPU spikes on the router boxes or blocking GC? Can you share host metrics for the timeframe?

maria_support: CPU on router pool nodes spiked ~70% -> 95% for a minute; no OOMs, small GC blips. Here's the prometheus graf: https://redwood/grafana/d/abc/tool-router-cpu

josh_cs: Confirmed — customer "MapleHealth" reported degraded user experience (~2-7s responses). They're on Dedicated but using our routed hosted tool router for structured output. They're asking for immediate mitigation.

anil_runtime: Short-term mitigations we can do now: 1) Flip structured_output.validation_mode=async (run validation off the critical path) 2) Toggle feature flag to skip schema validation for routes marked fast_path=true 3) Revert v0.9 -> v0.8 validator (less strict, cheaper) 4) Route traffic to non-validator fallback model variant.

maria_support: which is fastest to apply? We need something customer-facing within 15-30m.

kevin_sre: I can flip the feature flag svc-toolrouter.skip_schema via the console (runtime feature flags). Recommend a 10% canary, then 100% if green. If we need faster, I can do immediate 100% but prefer canary.

anil_runtime: If we want an immediate code hotfix, add a short-circuit in router:

```
# pseudocode
if route.meta.fast_path and output.size > 1024:
    skip_schema_validation()
else:
    validate_schema_sync()
```

That avoids validating large outputs synchronously. I'll open a tiny PR and can ship a canary in ~20m.

kevin_sre: I'll start the flag canary now. Maria — can you coordinate notes to MapleHealth that we're rolling a mitigation and expect improvement within ~10min?

maria_support: yes, pinged them. Also capturing repro steps for postmortem: 1) call /v1/call-tool with tool formatters returning large arrays (>2k items) 2) observe router validate_json_schema latency in logs 3) CPU spike on router pool.

deploy-bot: deploy started: svc-toolrouter/flag-update by kevin_sre (canary 10%). build: 2026.03.17-flag-skip-schema

deploy-bot: deploy success: canary 10% rolled.

anil_runtime: early canary telemetry: validator latency down ~65% for canary traffic; overall p99 for tool calls dropped from ~6.2s -> ~1.8s on canary slice.

kevin_sre: increasing to 100% now.

deploy-bot: deploy success: canary -> 100% complete.

maria_support: Customer updated — they report noticeable improvement, response times now ~1.9s p99. Thanks.

elaine_product: please file an incident and postmortem (assign to eng-runtime + SRE + support). Action items: evaluate async validation, add cost metrics for schema validation per-route, update docs about validator cost with large outputs, consider defaulting to async for large schemas.

anil_runtime: agreed. I'll open follow-ups: 1) async validator RFC + perf tests 2) opt-in stricter schema mode with sampling 3) router-level config for schema thresholds (size/complexity).

maria_support: adding timeline to the incident doc and customer notes. Closing here now that customer is stable.

kevin_sre: follow-up check in 1h to verify no regression.

maria_support: confirmed no new alerts after 30m. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
